paper.title: Online learning in MDPs with linear function approximation and bandit feedback

settings.name_in_paper: Online learning in episodic linear MDPs with adversarial rewards and bandit feedback
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Episodic MDP (reinforcement learning) with adversarial rewards, not a bandit problem.
unmapped: episodic layered MDP with horizon H and T episodes
linear MDP: transitions P(.|x,a)=<m(.),phi(x,a)> and rewards r_{t,h}(x,a)=<theta_{t,h},phi(x,a)>
the learner knows the transition function P exactly (simulator access)
feature covariance of uniform policy has eigenvalues >= lambda_min > 0 (Assumption 2); learner knows lambda_min for tuning M
settings.definition_quote: we consider an online learning problem where the learner interacts with its environment in a sequence of episodes t=1,2,...,T, facing a different reward functions r_{t,1}, ... r_{t,H+1} selected by a (possibly adaptive) adversary at the beginning of each episode t. ... observes the reward r_{t,h}(X_{t,h}, A_{t,h}).

bound.expression_latex: 2T \sigma R H\cdot \exp(-\gamma\beta\lambda_{\min} M) + \gamma H T + \eta HdT\frac{4}{3} + \frac{1}{\eta}D(\mu^*\|\mu_{0}) + \frac{1}{\alpha}D_C(u^*\|\mu_{0}) + \sqrt{\alpha \varepsilon }(M+2) H T

symbols.beta_mgr: Matrix Geometric Resampling step parameter beta
symbols.lambda_min: lower bound on eigenvalues of uniform-policy feature covariance
symbols.eps_opt: optimisation accuracy epsilon of the inner convex problem

tuning: Z_t solves G_t up to additive error epsilon

source.label: th_regret
source.quote: Then, for $\gamma\in (0,1)$, $M \ge 0$, any positive $\eta \le \frac{2}{(M+2) H}$ and any positive $\beta \le \frac{1}{2\sigma^2}$, the expected regret of \ftrlrl over $T$ episodes satisfies \regret_T \le 2T \sigma R H\cdot \exp(-\gamma\beta\lambdamin M) + \gamma H T + \eta HdT\frac{4}{3} + \frac{1}{\eta}D(\mu^*\|\mu_{0}) + \frac{1}{\alpha}\DC(u^*\|\mu_{0}) + \sqrt{\alpha \varepsilon }(M+2) H T.

results.notes: Paper's sigma (feature norm) mapped to L_feat, R (parameter norm) to S. Regret defined via occupancy measures against best stationary policy, i.e. pseudo-regret. Out-of-scope MDP setting.

bound.regime: T large enough so that constraints on M, gamma, eta, beta hold

symbols.eps_opt: optimisation accuracy epsilon of the inner convex problem

tuning: M = ceil(2 sigma^2 log(T H sigma R)/(gamma lambda_min))

source.label: th_regret
source.quote: Furthermore, letting $\beta = \frac{1}{2\sigma^2}$, $M = \left\lceil\frac{ 2 \sigma^2 \log (T H \sigma R)}{\gamma \lambdamin}\right\rceil$, $\eta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{TdH }}$, $\alpha = \frac{1}{\sqrt{TdH }}$ and $\gamma = \frac{1}{\sqrt{TH}}$ ... we also have \regret_T \le \sqrt{dHT} (2 + D(\mu^*\|\mu_0) + \DC(u^*\|\mu_0)) + \sqrt{HT} + \sqrt{ \varepsilon }T^{5/4}(Hd)^{1/4} + 2.

results.notes: With epsilon = T^{-3/2} the paper states O(sqrt(dHT D(mu*||mu_0))).
